text_block_list.text:
"The third leg of the Classic races,
and the day of the 'Kikuka Sho', with the 'Triple Crown' on the line—"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whoaa... My heart's pounding so fast~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The fans are watching super closely too,
to see if I can pull off the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I wonder if the Prez
felt this way too...
choice_data_list: I might've been crying because I was so scared.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Jeez! There's no way the Prez would be scared or cry!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure the President's got plenty of room to spare!
Just stand tall and proud!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, right.
In that case, I have to hold my head high too!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"After all, I'm gonna become the 'Emperor' (Teio)
who surpasses the 'Emperor' (Rudolf)!"
choice_data_list: Go out there and become a "Triple Crown Umamusume"!
Go out there and become a "Triple Crown Umamusume"!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yup, I'm off!
Today's star is yours truly, Tokai Teio!
